label: Retry Until Pass
description: Run a workflow again and again until its 'passed' return is true: generate, verify, and try again with the reviewer's feedback. Each attempt receives 'attempt' and 'feedback' variables.

inputs.name: in
inputs.label: Input
inputs.description: Passed to the workflow as its 'input' variable.

inputs.name: variables
inputs.label: Variables
inputs.description: Object of extra named values passed to every attempt.

inputs.name: workflow
inputs.label: Workflow Override
inputs.description: Workflow id or name, overriding the configured one.

outputs.name: pass
outputs.label: Pass
outputs.description: The result, when an attempt passed.

outputs.name: fail
outputs.label: Fail
outputs.description: The last result, when no attempt passed.

outputs.name: out
outputs.label: Result
outputs.description: The last attempt's result, passed or not.

outputs.name: returns
outputs.label: All Returns
outputs.description: Every value the last attempt returned.

outputs.name: error
outputs.label: Error
outputs.description: Error message if the step failed. Wire it to handle failures yourself; leave it unwired and the node fails visibly instead.
